lines.text: Her beloved comes leaping across the mountains and stands behind their wall, gazing through the windows.
He calls her to arise and come away, for the winter is past and the season of singing has come.
She wants the little foxes caught and calls him to be a gazelle on the mountains of Carmel.
She seeks him in bed at night, then asks the city shepherds if they have seen him.
She brings him to her mother's house and tells Jerusalem's daughters not to awaken love until the time is right.
